title: FRESCO: Efficient Subgraph Enumeration for Scalable Clustering in Heterogeneous CGRAs
problem: Clustering for heterogeneous CGRAs with complex clusters (100+ primitives, many bypassable) is computationally intractable because it is analogous to CISC instruction selection with orders of magnitude more complex instructions.
motivation: FPGA-CGRA hybrid architectures with rich heterogeneous resources require efficient clustering algorithms for design automation tools to remain practical.
method: FRESCO proposes a two-phase architecture-agnostic clustering algorithm: (1) first phase enumerates potential cluster matches using abstract decision tree strategy to efficiently prune search space, (2) second phase selects optimal cover from enumerated matches.
key_novelty: Abstract decision tree-based enumeration strategy that effectively prunes search space for complex heterogeneous clusters.
contributions: Architecture-agnostic clustering algorithm scaling to highly complex clusters
Abstract decision tree strategy for efficient subgraph match enumeration
Effective pruning mechanism reducing search space for complex clusters
Superior clustering quality versus CLUMAP state-of-the-art for supported cases
limitations: Evaluation on circuits with clusters already designed; applicability to automatically generated heterogeneous clusters not evaluated.
